title: mut.motion_evolve
mutation_directive: MOTION-GRAPH EVOLUTION (MAP-Elites style — fill the motion-behavior grid). The repo has a 10-word motion vocabulary at scripts/motion_graph.json: DRIFT (slow Brownian), PULSE (rhythmic in/out), CASCADE (gravity-led top-to-bottom), SPIRAL (rotational+radial), MURMUR (boids-collective), ASCEND (gravity-defying rise), SHATTER (explosive divergence), TRACE (line-laying through time), BREATHE (global scale modulation), PROPAGATE (wavefront across space). Read the parent piece's motion. Pick a NEIGHBORING motion word from the adjacency graph (or jump if the parent uses pure rotation — rotation is OVER-REPRESENTED, user explicitly flagged it 2026-05-07). Replace the parent's motion law with the chosen word's KINETIC + PHYSICS recipe (above). REQUIRED OUTPUT: the new HTML must include this comment near the top, exactly: <!-- MOTION: <chosen_word>, intensity: <calm|gentle|vigorous|explosive> --> (this lets the gallery classify and grid the piece into MAP-Elites cells). Pick whichever motion word is MOST ABSENT from the parent's lineage_path. The point is COVERAGE — every motion word should have at least one strong descendant before any one word gets a third.
